meta.title: YA Workspace Sidebar
meta.description: Replaces the DSH workspace sidebar: a global virtual-scrolled Recent Sessions list on top, a draggable separator, and a two-level Workspace → Session browser with breadcrumb navigation, local-date grouping, relative last-used times, pinning, unread dots, and right-click menus; add/rename/delete/fork/archive still use native host abilities.
